description: Enables real-time collaboration in TmNotionEditor — live cursor presence indicators and block change broadcasting. Typically implemented over SignalR. Collaboration features are hidden when this provider is not supplied.

properties.name: OnBlockChanged
properties.description: Observable stream of remote block changes broadcast by other collaborators. The editor subscribes to this and reloads affected blocks when an event arrives.

properties.name: OnCursorMoved
properties.description: Observable stream of cursor position updates from other collaborators. Used to render live cursor overlays.

methods.name: JoinPageAsync
methods.description: Registers the current user as an active collaborator on the page. Called when the editor navigates to a page.

methods.name: LeavePageAsync
methods.description: Removes the current user from the active collaborators list. Called on page navigation away and component disposal.

methods.name: BroadcastBlockChangeAsync
methods.description: Broadcasts a block mutation to all other collaborators on the page.

parameters.name: change
parameters.description: Describes which block changed and how.

methods.name: BroadcastCursorAsync
methods.description: Broadcasts the current user's caret position to other collaborators.

methods.name: GetActiveCollaboratorsAsync
methods.description: Returns the current cursor positions of all other active collaborators on the page. Called on initial join.
